name: Sylphia Lumina Winstoll
original_name: シルフィア・ルミナ・ウィンストル
source:
A kind princess bound by a curse.

"I must be a condemned soul. The curse on me will surely bring you down as well."

Princess of the Kingdom of Winstoll.
She's demure and shy but has a tender heart that cares deeply for nature and all living things, constantly praying for the well-being of her subjects. 
Because of a particular curse she carries, she was raised in seclusion within the castle walls. Summoned to the castle as Gran's betrothed due to a pact between him and King Winstoll, she is groomed as the sacrificial lamb for a mysterious ritual.

[Translated from [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/testament/chara01.html]official website[/url]]
